title: fix(github): stabilize standards rendering and automerge triggers
summary: Rendering preserves standards pins and exposes post-test artifact paths.
details: Export ARTIFACTS_DIR for validation steps and stop the renderer from overwriting the selected standard SHA.

Original GitHub merge e5a57189cfb796fe65b44eae6a646a9ea3e41e56 is distinct from rewritten main-history delivery 37828e40e19ce18664ac17a4d5491ea81d694fd4; the merge date is the verified GitHub date.
